transfer_provisions.section: Chapter I, secs. 1-23, 1-29, 1-30 (prescribed by the order)
transfer_provisions.quote: Officers and employees of the Foreign Service are prohibited from accepting, under any circumstances, any present, decoration, medal, order, or testimonial that may be tendered to them by any foreign sovereign, head of state, or foreign government.
transfer_provisions.note: Sec. 1-23 re-prescribes, for all officers and employees, the prohibition on foreign presents that EO 7577 had written into Instructions sec. XV-4 and Consular Regulations sec. 451. Secs. 1-29 and 1-30 re-prescribe the retirement rules that EO 8177 had written as FSR sec. III-19 (Part I) and II-31 (Part II). These are successor provisions inside the same order, not a savings clause.

effective_date_reading: The order has no effective-date, delayed-effect or phase-in wording in the held text. It was signed April 18, 1940, filed April 19 and printed 5 FR 1461 on April 20, 1940; the project takes an order with no effective wording to be effective on signing, so the revocations of EO 7577, 8078 and 8177 are dated 1940-04-18.

conclusion: EO 8396 (signed 1940-04-18, 5 FR 1461-1464, read once in full) amends the Foreign Service Regulations by prescribing Chapter I (Foreign Service Personnel, secs. 1-1 to 1-30), cancels listed sections of Parts I and II of the Regulations ('Cancellation of Regulations'), and revokes by number nine Executive Orders (171, 2406, 4879, 4892, 5642, 7497, 7577, 8078, 8177) and paragraphs 3 and 4 of EO 8185 ('Revocation of Executive Orders'). It contains no savings, continuation, pending-matter, transfer-of-property or exception clause and no effective-date wording. The cancellation list reads (OCR) Part I sections IV-8, IV-9, V-1 to V-5, V-7, VIII-8, VIII-10, VIII-12, VIII-15, XV-1, XV-2, XV-5 to XV-7, XVI-2, XVI-4 to XVI-6 and XVI-21, then 'Chapter HE.' (apparently Chapter III); Part II sections XXIV-434 to XXIV-436, XXIV-438, XXIV-451, XXIV-452, XXIV-456 and XXIV-459, then 'Chapters I and II'. It does not list sec. XV-4 of Part I (the section EO 7577 amended) or sec. V-15 (the Tariff of Fees that EO 8078 amended). Whether the revocations undo the text those orders had already written into the Regulations is not stated.
